patch_resolves_note: The fix commit (371305f) modifies X509_verify to push an error on signature algorithm mismatch. This is unrelated to the PEM_read_bio use-of-uninitialized-value bug in crypto/pem/pem_lib.c. The vulnerable code is identical in both versions.

nodes.description: strncmp(buf, "-----BEGIN ", 11) unconditionally reads 11 bytes of buf regardless of how many bytes BIO_gets initialized. With a 1-byte PoC, only 2 bytes are initialized (buf[0..1]) but 11 are accessed.
nodes.evidence: Vulnerable trace shows bytes_initialized=2 < comparison_length=11 at strncmp_site

edges.description: BIO_gets writes bytes_written=1 byte into buf, but strncmp reads comparison_length=11 bytes. The gap (11 > 1) represents uninitialised memory access.

root_cause_criterion.description: char buf[256] declared without initialization. No code path guarantees 11 initialized bytes before strncmp(buf, "-----BEGIN ", 11). The fix should initialize buf or bound the comparison to the number of bytes read.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The required assertion is violated in the vulnerable trace (bytes_initialized=2 < 11 while strncmp executes). The patch (371305f) does not modify PEM_read_bio, so the fix-side differential cannot confirm the obligation is met post-fix. Verification is based on the vulnerable-side violation being structurally correct: the missing initialization obligation is directly evidenced by the MSAN crash at this site.
